<\STATESEP>theory Helpers_CAMKES
imports Types_CAMKES
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  lookup :: "('a \<times> 'b) list \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'b"
where (* Assumes the filter will return a unique element. *)
  "lookup xs x = snd (hd (filter (\<lambda>y. (x = (fst y))) xs))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "from_components conn  \<equiv> map fst (conn_from conn)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "from_interfaces conn  \<equiv> map snd (conn_from conn)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "to_components conn    \<equiv> map fst (conn_to conn)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "to_interfaces conn    \<equiv> map snd (conn_to conn)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "in_map conns xs \<equiv> (\<exists>s\<in>set conns. s \<in> (fst ` (set xs)))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "does_provide c s \<equiv> (in_map s (provides c))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "does_require c s \<equiv> (in_map s (requires c))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "does_emit c s    \<equiv> (in_map s (emits c))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "does_consume c s \<equiv> (in_map s (consumes c))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation "has_dataport c s \<equiv> (in_map s (dataports c))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
